# VideoFactory voice settings

Two ways to get a voice. Both make the same video.

1. **Free: record it yourself.** Read `01_voice/script.md` aloud and save the file in `01_voice/`
   (`voice.wav`, `.m4a` or `.mp3`). Any phone or laptop microphone works in a quiet room.
2. **Paid: ElevenLabs.** `python anim.py speak <slug>` uses the settings above. The key goes in the local `.env`
   (`ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=...`), never in a file you commit. Check your key and model first:
   `python anim.py speak <slug> --check`.

The voice above is "George", one of the default voices every ElevenLabs account has.
To change it, copy a voice id from the ElevenLabs voice library into `voice_id`.
If your plan does not have `eleven_v4`, `--check` lists the models you can use; put one in `model`.

Each video freezes these settings in its own `settings.json` when it is created, so a change here only affects new videos.
How to write a script for a voice, review it and listen to the result: `../../_shared/voice.md`.

brand.md.content:
# VideoFactory brand for animation (id: `videofactory`)

The house brand of this repo. It shows every brand part in one place, so a new brand can copy it.
Values live in `tokens.js`; this file says how to use them.

## Look
- Dark studio. Near-black field (`bg`), slightly lighter cards (`surface`), cream text (`ink`).
- One hot accent: factory orange `#FF5B2E`. Use it for the one thing the viewer must look at. Never for body text.
- One cool second voice: violet `#7C5CFF`. Use it for a contrast idea, a second series in a chart, or a tag.
- Green `#3DDC84` means done or correct. Red `#FF4D5E` means wrong or stop. Use them for nothing else.
- Soft depth: big rounded cards (28 px corners), deep soft shadows, two slow glows in the background. No hard outlines, no textures.
- Big type with tight letter spacing. Few words on screen; the voice carries the detail.

## Fonts (all SIL Open Font License, local in `_runtime/fonts/`)
- Headings: Archivo, weight 750–800.
- Body: Inter.
- Labels, numbers in code, kickers: JetBrains Mono, uppercase with wide spacing.
- Hand notes: Caveat, at most one per shot.

## Logo
- `logo/mark.svg`: the mark in brand colours. `logo/mark-mono.svg`: one colour (`currentColor`).
- The word mark is live text: `Video` in `ink` and `Factory` in `accent`, Archivo 800. Do not stretch or recolour the mark.

## Motion
- Things enter fast and land soft (`rise`, `words`, `pop` in `_shared/modern.md`). Exits are short.
- Each shot has one entrance moment on a spoken cue. Do not animate what the voice does not mention.
- The motion pack in `library/motion/` uses the same tokens.

## Sound
- Soft clicks, whooshes and pops, never chiptune. Files and their licences: `sound/SOURCES.md`.

## Cast
- None. All people in examples are invented. Never use a real customer, quote or face.

## Tone
Rules: `_shared/tone.md`. Brand notes: friendly maker, plain English, short sentences, no hype words.
Audience: people who want to make explainer videos with an AI agent and do not want to learn video software.
Call to action: "Clone the repo and run `/vf-setup`."

tokens.js.content:
// VideoFactory brand tokens: the house brand of this repo. Dark studio look, one warm accent, one cool accent.
// Keep this file flat: one key per line, single quotes, no helpers. Checkers read it with a regex.
window.BrandTokens = {
  id: 'videofactory', // same as the folder name in brands/
  name: 'VideoFactory',
  bg: '#0B0B10', // page background
  surface: '#16161F', // cards, windows, panels
  raised: '#20202C', // parts inside a card
  ink: '#F5F2EA', // main text
  dim: '#B4B1BF', // secondary text
  faint: '#77758A', // labels and muted text
  line: '#2C2C3A', // borders and dividers
  accent: '#FF5B2E', // brand orange: the one thing to look at
  accent2: '#7C5CFF', // violet: the second voice
  green: '#3DDC84', // success
  danger: '#FF4D5E', // error
  ramp: ['#0B0B10','#16161F','#8A2E14','#FF5B2E','#FF9A6B','#FFD8C7','#F5F2EA','#FBF9F4'], // darkest to lightest; 3 = accent, 6 = cream
  font: '"Inter", system-ui, sans-serif', // body text
  head: '"Archivo", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif', // headings
  mono: '"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace', // labels and code
  hand: '"Caveat", cursive', // handwritten notes
  grads: [['#FF5B2E','#FFB547'],['#7C5CFF','#C084FC'],['#14B8A6','#5EEAD4'],['#3DDC84','#A3E635'],['#FF4D8D','#FF9A6B']], // gradient pairs [from, to]
};
